Only my sister still communicates with him, which is something I don't fully understand. I host a lot of family events at my houseâĢĶbirthdays, Easter, Christmas parties, etc. Since the divorce, I've made it clear that I don't want him in my home. I've stopped inviting him to any events. My sister was upset about this because she thought their kids would be upset about not having their dad at big events. She hates him for cheating but acknowledges that they have kids together, so they're stuck with each other for life. The ex-husband's behavior was really hurtful and caused a lot of trauma, so it's understandable that I don't want him around. In terms of Christian values, I believe in forgiveness and love, but that doesn't necessarily mean I have to invite someone into my home who has caused harm. It's about protecting my family and maintaining a healthy environment. I think it's possible to forgive someone without reconciling or allowing them into my personal space.
